title: How customers want to be contacted
transcript:
Consultant: Any compliance pressure on outreach?
Client: Some. People tell us they prefer email or phone and we lose it.
Consultant: Lose it where?
Client: It goes in a note and nobody reads notes. We need a preferred
contact channel on the contact record, picklist, email or phone or none.
Consultant: Including an explicit none.
Client: Especially the none. That is the one that gets us in trouble.

expected.note: Picklist on Contact including an explicit opt-out value. Named as the client named it - 'preferred contact channel' - after the first run showed the ground truth had abbreviated it.
